given: the operator has entered a SKU, location, quantity, and tracking code on the filing screen
then: the screen shows an explicit success confirmation naming that the stock was filed, rather than failing silently or leaving the operator on an unchanged form
architectural_notes: E2E: the user-facing feedback outcome. The React SPA filing page (client/src/pages + client/src/hooks) renders an explicit success confirmation off the JSON boundary's success response (app/routes/stock.py returns a data payload the client renders, per R5's SPA / JSON-API split). No business logic lives in the boundary or the client; the confirmation is presentation over the persisted outcome. This AC can regress while persistence still works, so it is a distinct client-side assertion covered by the client component tests plus the E2E flow, with the write path covered by the paired-branch suite (R4).

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 assert the persisted-state outcome (a record exists / is updated); AC3 asserts the distinct user-facing feedback outcome, that a submission surfaces an explicit success confirmation, which can break while persistence still succeeds and vice versa.
